Saves your guest home to a file you choose (local storage, Drive or any document provider). It is a zstd-compressed tar with a sha256 checksum.

Pick a backup file. It is checked against its checksum, unpacked into a staging folder, then moved into your home. Choose per top-level entry: Merge keeps files you already have; Replace moves them aside to .replaced-<time>. If anything fails the move is undone.

ed25519 keypairs in ~/.ssh. Copy the public key to the remote\'s authorized_keys. The private key never leaves this phone.
